definition: `InPotency x r`: x is in potency to r, able to be r without being r actually; what is actually hot is at the same time cold in potency. A parameter in Lean, constrained by the same premises as `InAct`; nothing defines it as the negation of act. That gloss, 'able to be r without being r actually', is the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis (STMT-POTENCY-IS-UNACTUALIZED-CAPACITY). If it were made the Lean definition of `InPotency`, STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT would become analytic; the analysis is satisfiable exactly when that premise holds (result ACT-POTENCY-DEFINITIONAL-ANALYSES-CONSERVATIVE), so this would move the premise's openness to the analysis's fidelity without discharging it. `InPotency` therefore stays a parameter.
